name: Hotjar
tagline: Website heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
verdictSummary: Tracking clicks and mouse movements on a webpage is fundamentally a JavaScript snippet that records DOM events and sends them to a server for replay. A basic heatmap is a 2D density plot of click coordinates. One-shot doable with rrweb for recording and a simple canvas for heatmap rendering.
coreLoopDIY: Click/move tracking script + heatmap renderer + session replay viewer
whatYouLose: Large-scale data pipeline for high-traffic sites
whyPeopleStillPay: Turnkey setup, no infrastructure to manage, and built-in compliance for enterprise data privacy
notes: Great DIY candidate for small sites. At scale, the data pipeline becomes the real challenge.
